name: prototype
summary: Prototype at the right fidelity and validate at each level instead of skipping to pixels.

when: a flow, wireframe or clickable prototype is wanted
a design needs testing with users

steps: Pick the fidelity the QUESTION needs. Content outline answers information needs; a high-fi mockup answers none of them and costs eight hours.
Do not skip levels. Each one validates something the next assumes.
Map the flow with its decision points, its error paths and its edge cases — a happy path is not a flow.
Five users catches most of it. Write the task, not the instruction.
output: The artefact at the named fidelity, plus what it will be used to validate.
done: the fidelity matches the question being asked
error and edge paths are drawn, not just the happy path
